Oracle released FY2027 Q1 results on 10 September 2026. The quarter ended on 31 August 2026. No same-period preview exists. An after-the-fact reconstruction is not a preview.

Total revenue was USD 19.345 billion. Revenue increased 30% year over year. Cloud revenue was USD 11.607 billion. Cloud revenue increased 62% year over year. Cloud revenue was about 60% of total revenue. IaaS revenue was about USD 7.4 billion. IaaS revenue increased 121% year over year. SaaS revenue was about USD 4.2 billion. SaaS revenue increased 10% year over year. IaaS was the main growth driver.

Operating income has two reported bases. GAAP operating income was about USD 6.7 billion. Non-GAAP operating income was about USD 8.2 billion. The difference was about USD 1.5 billion. Do not mix the two bases.

Remaining performance obligations were USD 664 billion. Free cash flow was negative USD 5 billion. The supplied facts did not provide cash-flow reconciliation details. This draft does not attribute the negative free cash flow to a specific item.

The supplied facts did not provide pre-quarter consensus or guidance. This draft cannot quantify an actual-versus-expected difference. Because there is no same-period preview, there is no prior judgment to review.

Next quarter is FY2027 Q2, ending 30 November 2026. Watch IaaS growth, SaaS growth, RPO change, and free cash flow. These are observation points, not company guidance.
